title: Inverter shows fault code E032
summary: Inverter displaying fault code E032 (grid overvoltage) due to firmware 3.5.1 sensitivity bug. OTA firmware update interrupted by network instability, leaving inverter in recovery mode. Remote rescue firmware push performed; unit rebooted and now running 3.5.2. Fault code cleared, no recurrence.

title: Battery storage not charging after storm
summary: Home battery system stopped accepting charge following a thunderstorm. Customer suspects lightning surge. BMS logs show overcurrent protection triggered.

title: Monitoring app not syncing data
summary: Customer's monitoring portal stopped refreshing data for 3 days. Root cause was expired OAuth token on the gateway. Token renewed remotely; data sync confirmed restored.

title: Microinverter on panel 7 offline
summary: Single microinverter reporting no communication for 2 weeks. On-site visit confirmed hardware failure. Unit replaced under warranty.

title: Grid export blocked by utility
summary: Customer unable to export excess solar to grid. Utility imposed temporary export limit due to local grid constraints. Awaiting utility approval to restore full export rights.

title: Inverter fan making grinding noise
summary: Customer reports continuous grinding noise from inverter fan. Unit still producing power normally. Fan replacement part ordered, scheduled for installation next week.

title: EV charger integration not working
summary: Smart EV charger not responding to solar surplus signals from inverter. Protocol mismatch between OCPP 1.6 charger and inverter's HEMS interface.

title: Production report shows zero output overnight
summary: Customer alarmed by zero kWh production between 22:00 and 06:00. Explained normal behavior as panels only produce during daylight. Case closed after education.

title: Thermal hotspot detected on roof panel
summary: IR scan during routine inspection revealed hotspot on panel row 3, string 2. Possible cell degradation or internal delamination. Replacement panel on order.

title: Firmware update failed mid-process
summary: Over-the-air firmware update interrupted by network dropout, leaving inverter in recovery mode. Remote recovery procedure executed successfully; firmware 3.7.2 now running.

title: Incorrect energy billing from utility
summary: Customer disputes utility bill showing higher import than monitoring portal logs. Awaiting meter data from utility to reconcile with inverter production data. On hold pending utility response.

title: Battery not switching to backup mode during outage
Monitoring shows negative consumption values
summary: Dashboard displaying -2.3 kW consumption at night. Likely CT clamp installed inverted on main supply feed. Technician assigned to verify and correct CT orientation.

title: Panels covered in bird droppings reducing output
summary: Customer reports 15% production drop over 3 months. Remote diagnostic confirmed soiling loss. Customer instructed on safe panel cleaning procedure. Output restored after cleaning.

title: Smart meter communication error
summary: Home energy manager losing connection to smart meter every 48–72 hours. Suspected interference from new WiFi 6 router. Workaround applied by switching meter to Zigbee channel 26.

title: Inverter not reconnecting after grid outage
summary: Unit remained in safe-state isolation 4 hours after grid was restored. Firmware update 3.8.0 had reset the reconnect delay to factory default (300 s). Setting corrected remotely via service portal; inverter reconnected and resumed normal operation.

title: Annual yield well below projection
summary: Customer expected 6,200 kWh/year but system produced only 4,800 kWh. Analysis ongoing: shading report and irradiation data comparison pending. On hold for third-party assessment.

title: Moisture ingress in junction box
summary: Installer reported water marks inside combiner box during maintenance visit. Sealant failure suspected. Replacement junction box being procured; temporary waterproofing applied.

title: Installer app cannot commission new inverter
summary: Setup wizard fails at step 4 (grid profile selection) when trying to commission replacement unit. France grid profile appears missing from firmware 3.6.1. Escalated to engineering.

title: String 2 producing 30% less than string 1
summary: Performance ratio disparity between east and west roof strings investigated. West string has new 15-year-old tree shadow not present at system design. Shading analysis updated.

title: System not entering self-consumption mode
summary: Battery continuously exporting to grid instead of covering household load. Firmware update 3.8.0 had silently reset the self-consumption mode setting to factory default (off). Setting corrected remotely via service portal; self-consumption mode confirmed active.

title: Corrosion visible on MC4 connectors
summary: Field technician found oxidation on 6 MC4 connectors during inspection. Open-circuit risk identified. Connector replacement in progress; system partially offline during repair.

title: Battery depth of discharge alarm
summary: System repeatedly triggering low-state-of-charge alarm at 10% SoC even during daytime. Capacity degradation suspected. Scheduled battery health test via remote diagnostics.

title: Heatpump integration causing inverter overload
summary: Heat pump peak draw (4.2 kW) combined with other loads exceeding inverter's 5 kW limit. Load management rules need tuning. Awaiting smart home integrator response.

title: Panels not producing during overcast sky
summary: Customer expected output on cloudy day but saw only 5–8% of peak capacity. Normal diffuse irradiation behavior explained. No fault found.

title: Inverter overheating in summer
summary: Inverter entering thermal derating above 45°C ambient. Ventilation clearance found to be 5 cm instead of required 10 cm. Customer repositioned unit; overheating resolved.

title: Export meter showing incorrect tariff
summary: Feed-in-tariff meter recording exports at wrong rate code. Utility configuration mismatch. Case raised with billing team; metering config correction pending.

title: Rapid shutdown device not triggering
summary: Emergency responder reported RSD system non-responsive during fire drill. Firmware incompatibility between module-level RSD and new inverter version. Patch in development.

title: System not visible in fleet management portal
summary: Newly installed system not appearing in operator's fleet dashboard. Gateway serial number registered to wrong partner account. Account mapping corrected.

title: Daily production graph missing data gaps
summary: Monitoring portal showing gaps in hourly graph. Confirmed gateway went offline briefly due to ISP maintenance windows. Data gaps are cosmetic only; production counters are accurate.

title: AC isolator switch tripping randomly
summary: AC disconnect tripping every few days without fault code. Extended trip logging confirmed the internal arc-detection relay contact was arcing under load, causing spurious trips. Relay contact found worn on inspection. Replacement relay installed and tested; no further nuisance trips observed.

title: Home energy storage warranty claim
summary: Battery capacity measured at 68% of rated after 4 years. Warranty threshold is 70% at year 10. Customer claims premature degradation. Technical review of cycle history in progress. On hold pending engineering assessment.

title: Inverter error MPPT1 input overvoltage
summary: Fault triggered during cold morning startup when Voc briefly exceeded MPPT operating range. String recalculated for winter Voc; one panel removed from string. No recurrence.

title: Isolation resistance fault on DC side
summary: Inverter reporting low insulation resistance (< 200 kΩ) on DC string 1. Ground fault suspected. Technician dispatched for ground fault locator test.

title: Power optimiser reporting lost communication
summary: Two power optimisers on south array showing offline in monitoring. PLC communication issue on string bus suspected. Remote diagnostics running; field visit may be required.

title: Inverter time clock drifting
summary: System time drifting up to 12 minutes per week causing incorrect time-of-use tariff optimisation. NTP server address was empty after factory reset. Reconfigured; drift resolved.

title: Battery cannot be discharged below 20%
summary: Customer wants deeper discharge for backup reserve. System correctly configured to minimum 20% reserve per local grid code. Customer briefed; no change required.

title: DC cable insulation damaged by pest
summary: Squirrel chewed through DC cable insulation causing intermittent arc faults. Arc fault protection correctly isolated the string. Cable replacement and cable armor conduit installation scheduled.

title: Panel mismatch after partial replacement
summary: Three replacement panels from different manufacturer batch have 5W lower Pmax causing string imbalance. MPPT efficiency reduced. Investigating panel spec compatibility.

title: API access for third-party energy manager refused
summary: Customer's third-party energy management system cannot authenticate to monitoring API. OAuth2 client credentials revoked after policy change. Awaiting security team approval to reissue.

title: Installer requesting extended data retention
summary: Installer requested 5-year historical data export for customer audit. Standard portal provides 12 months. Full dataset exported from data warehouse and sent securely.

title: Zero export relay not operating correctly
summary: Zero-export protection relay failing to curtail inverter output when grid import drops to zero. Relay contact found worn. Replacement relay installed and tested.

title: Shadow management algorithm disabled after update
summary: Panels in afternoon shade showing 20% lower output after firmware 4.0 upgrade. Firmware update 4.0 had silently reset the shade optimisation setting to factory default (off). Setting corrected remotely via service portal; DRED shade management confirmed active and output recovering.

title: Ground mount tracking system not following sun
summary: Single-axis tracker on ground-mount array stuck at morning angle all day. Controller board fault suspected. Replacement controller dispatched; system producing at suboptimal fixed tilt in the meantime.
